title: Marked semistable alteration of a curve over an arbitrary excellent base
statement:
Let $f:C\to B$ be a proper dominant morphism of integral excellent Noetherian schemes. Suppose its generic fibre has dimension $1$, and let $Z\subset C$ be a proper closed subset. There exist integral excellent Noetherian schemes $C',B'$, alterations $a:C'\to C$ and $b:B'\to B$, and a morphism $f':C'\to B'$ with $fa=bf'$. The morphism $f'$ is proper, flat and of finite presentation. Its geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are nonempty connected reduced curves of pure dimension $1$, smooth except at ordinary double points, and its generic fibre is smooth and geometrically integral. There are finitely many disjoint sections $s_i:B'\to C'$ into the relative smooth locus and a proper closed subset $T\subset B'$ such that $a^{-1}(Z)\subseteq\bigcup_i s_i(B')\cup f'^{-1}(T)$. An ordinary double point has completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ on a geometric fibre over an algebraically closed field $\Omega$. An alteration here is a proper surjective morphism finite over a dense open of its integral target. No projectivity or affineness hypothesis on $B$ is imposed.

The notions of proper, integral, excellent, Noetherian, fibre, geometric integrality, dimension, finite morphism and generic point use [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-exc-excellent-ring], [pqf-def-locnoeth], [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], [def-pc-scheme-fibre], [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and [def-sc-generic-point]. Flatness, finite presentation and smoothness use [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. A section means a morphism $s_i$ with $f's_i=1_{B'}$.

source.place: Theorem 2.4 (i), (ii), and Remark 2.5, printed pp. 602--603, with trivial input group; forget the output group and projectivity. Situation 2.1 allows empty boundary and does not require geometrically irreducible or smooth generic fibre. Local PDF WANTED; publisher PDF read online.
